_comment: Reusable knowledge for content/marketing pages on hybrid sites where the body is semantic HTML or named component classes (aemds-*, wag-*, retail*, quicklinkcard, glider) rather than data-testid. classRoots maps a class-root regex to a block; build-catalog maps these like other blocks. Extend as new component roots appear.

health-content.name: Health/Wellness Article
health-content.complexityReason: Editorial health/wellness article: H1, sub-headings, rich body copy, lists, images, inline links — maps to EDS default content within a category-details wrapper. Content-authored, not a coded block.
functional: Renders article title (H1), section headings, paragraphs, lists and images.
Inline links to related conditions/products.
Sits under a health category (breadcrumb/category context).
acceptance: Article renders title + body with correct heading hierarchy.
Inline links resolve.
Images render with alt text.
verify: Open a /health or /topic article; confirm the body content renders.

quick-links.name: Quick Links / Category Shortcuts
quick-links.complexityReason: Grid/row of labelled icon shortcuts to key categories/services (homepage & landing pages).
functional: Row/grid of icon + label shortcut cards linking to categories/services.
acceptance: Each quick-link navigates to its target.

content-carousel.name: Content / Product Carousel
content-carousel.complexityReason: Horizontal glider/carousel of cards (products, offers, content) with prev/next; used on home, category and content pages.
functional: Horizontal carousel of cards with prev/next controls.
Each card links to a PDP/PLP/content page.
acceptance: Carousel scrolls via prev/next.
Cards link correctly.
verify: Scroll a glider carousel; click a card.

feature-tile.name: Feature Tile / Teaser
feature-tile.complexityReason: Image + heading + copy + CTA promotional tile (aemds-featuretile / cmp-teaser).
functional: Media + heading + copy + CTA promoting a page/offer.
acceptance: Tile renders media + heading; CTA navigates.

hero-banner.name: Hero Banner
hero-banner.complexityReason: Homepage/landing hero: background media, headline, CTA(s); may rotate.
functional: Background media + headline + CTA(s); may auto-rotate.
acceptance: Hero renders headline + CTA; rotation works if present.

promo-banner.name: Promo Banner
promo-banner.complexityReason: Sitewide promo strip above the header with rotating offer links.
functional: Rotating promotional offer links above the header.
acceptance: Promo links navigate to the offer/PLP.

login-form.name: Login / Sign-in Form
login-form.complexityReason: Email/password sign-in with validation, remember-me, forgot-password, and links to register; identity-service integrated.
functional: Email + password fields with validation.
Remember-me, forgot-password, create-account links.
Submit authenticates against the identity service.
acceptance: Invalid input shows validation errors.
Forgot-password / register links resolve.

order-pickup.name: Order Pickup / On-my-way
order-pickup.complexityReason: Store-pickup / on-my-way flow: order lookup, store info, continue steps, arrival notification. Session + order-service integrated.
functional: Order/pickup lookup and store info display.
Continue/confirm pickup steps; on-my-way arrival notification.
acceptance: Pickup flow shows store info and progresses through steps.
verify: Open a pickup/onmyway route; confirm the flow structure.

live-chat.name: Live Chat / Click-to-Chat
live-chat.complexityReason: Click-to-chat support widget (Zendesk/vendor) launched from a fixed button.
functional: Fixed chat button launches a support chat widget.
acceptance: Clicking the chat button opens the chat widget.
verify: Click the chat button; confirm widget opens.

rich-content.name: Rich Content (AEM DS)
rich-content.complexityReason: AEM Design-System rich content (aemds-title/body/link) — headings, body copy, links. Maps to EDS default content.
functional: Renders titles, body copy and links from the AEM DS.
acceptance: Rich content renders with correct hierarchy and links.

rx-refill.name: Rx Refill (guest/express)
rx-refill.complexityReason: Prescription refill checkout: enter Rx number (or scan), select pickup store & date, guest details, and submit to the pharmacy fulfillment system. HIPAA-sensitive, validated, session/pharmacy-API integrated.
functional: Enter prescription number (guest express) or scan to refill.
Select pickup store and pickup date/time.
Provide guest contact details; validation on all fields.
Submit refill to the pharmacy system with confirmation.
acceptance: Invalid Rx number shows validation.
A store + date can be selected.
Submitting a valid refill shows a confirmation.
Guest flow works without sign-in.
verify: Open /rx-checkout/guest-express-refill; confirm the Rx-number form + store/date selection.

rx-transfer.name: Rx Transfer
rx-transfer.complexityReason: Transfer a prescription to Walgreens: identify current pharmacy + medication, choose destination store, provide patient details, submit. HIPAA-sensitive, validated, pharmacy-API integrated.
functional: Identify current pharmacy and medication(s) to transfer.
Choose destination Walgreens store.
Provide patient details with validation.
Submit transfer request with confirmation.
acceptance: Required fields validate before submit.
A destination store can be selected.
Submitting shows a transfer confirmation.
verify: Open /rx-checkout/guest-transfer-rx; confirm the transfer form + store selection.

footer.name: Global Footer
footer.complexityReason: Sitewide mega-footer: customer service, myWalgreens, company info, terms/privacy, product category directory, photo products, social, newsletter signup and legal/copyright. Shared across all pages.
functional: Multi-column link groups: Customer Service, myWalgreens, Company Info, Terms, Privacy & Security.
Product category directory ('View all products by') + photo products.
Newsletter/deals signup, social links, copyright and legal (privacy/CCPA/Washington health).
'Your Privacy Choices' CCPA opt-out.
acceptance: Footer renders all link columns and legal links on every page.
Newsletter signup and social links work.
Privacy/CCPA links resolve.
verify: Confirm footer link columns and privacy links resolve.
